Okay, what on earth is going on right here between these two islands in Indonesia?
Over here in Bali, you've got tigers, monkeys, and rhinos ruling the jungle.
Jump just twenty miles across this water to Lombok, and every single Asian mammal is gone. Literally zero.
Instead? You get tree kangaroos and cockatoos from Australia! What is this, an animal border checkpoint?
Even birds with wings refuse to fly across it! So what is this secret invisible wall?
Well, during the Ice Age, the ocean dropped 300 feet, turning shallow sea into dry land.
Tigers could literally walk from mainland Asia all the way to Bali, but stopped right here.
Because this exact gap is an underwater canyon over a thousand feet deep that never dried up.
Two completely different worlds colliding, keeping them isolated for fifty million years.
